Details


Product Description



This adjustable keyboard stand is built for comfort, stability, and everyday performance. Featuring a durable metal frame with a 150 lb load capacity, it easily supports 88-key keyboards, digital pianos, MIDI controllers, and synths. The stand offers height adjustment from 25.5' to 33.5' and width adjustment from 28' to 42', allowing proper playing posture while seated or standing. Secure locking knobs keep your instrument firmly in place, while adjustable feet provide stability on uneven surfaces. Its foldable design makes this portable keyboard stand ideal for home practice, studio setups, and live gigs.


EXTRA USPs

Scratch Safe Contact Points



Quick Lock Adjustment Knobs



Table Style Design



Compact Storage Footprint




Protective contact surfaces help prevent marks and wear on your keyboard, maintaining the finish of digital pianos, MIDI controllers, and synths over time.



Smooth-turn locking knobs allow fast height and width adjustments, making it easy to fine-tune your setup without tools before practice, recording, or live performance.



The table style keyboard stand distributes weight evenly, helping keep full-size keyboards centered and steady during play—ideal for heavier digital pianos and performance setups.



When folded, the stand takes up minimal space, making it convenient for apartments, studios, classrooms, and shared music rooms.
